# Senegal OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **1 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Senegal ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Senegal national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Senegal public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Senegal in the United Kingdom — economic section

open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
